jobs.title: Director of Development
jobs.description:
Join Our Leadership Team

The ideal candidate is a driven and creative self-starter who is energized by opportunities to grow a small organization by securing a range of high-net-worth donors and sponsors, prioritizes relationships and sustainability, and can plan and execute a range of fundraising strategies with results. This is a chance to provide significant capacity-building support and growth to a high-impact, high-potential, and low-resourced organization in need of a skilled and experienced development leader. The ideal candidate would have a genuine passion for our mission of empowering disability communities globally and understands the importance of local sustainability for humanitarian work.

This is a part-time, remote, volunteer position with a minimum commitment of one year. We are looking for an individual that is deeply committed to our mission and would like to be a longer-term (potentially employed) team member, and is therefore motivated to grow our organization to enable this opportunity.

The Director of Development works with the Board of Directors Chairperson and with the executive leadership team (Executive Director, Director of Operations, Director of Communications, and Director of Programs) to learn the organization’s fundraising history and to obtain or co-develop supporting materials or content needed to implement a strategic fundraising plan. This position would oversee a small committee (2 - 4 individuals) committed to supporting development and campaign execution.

Director Of Development Responsibilities

Develop and implement a fundraising plan to meet the organization’s needs and goals for growth, which includes development and execution of a comprehensive fundraising campaign that raises $750,000 by May of 2028.
Identify and cultivate individual donors and major gift prospects, as well as corporate sponsors and foundation donors, with a focus on relationship-building and with the goal of securing new and renewed gifts in the first year and beyond
Plan and execute fundraising campaigns that engage donors and effectively communicate the mission and impact of the organization
Collaborate with executive leadership and Board of Directors to create and deliver highly professional, compelling presentations, pitch decks, reports, and other relevant materials to pitch, close, and steward fundraising opportunities
Create and facilitate donor calls, meetings, events, and experiences with great attention to detail, donor-targeted messaging, and highly professional execution
Network and leverage connections, including any personal connections or donor contacts that may lead to TBB’s growth and goal attainment
Collaborate with and direct other team members regarding fundraising initiatives and co-development of supporting materials or content needed for fundraising initiatives
Direct and supervise a small (2 - 4 individuals) fundraising committee
Monitor and analyze fundraising data to evaluate performance and adjust strategies

Director Of Development Qualifications (Required)

Excellent interpersonal, networking, and relationship-building skills
Extensive knowledge of fundraising strategies and principles
Demonstrated history of successful fundraising goal attainment and program advancement
Demonstrated success in soliciting and managing four and five figure (or beyond) gifts from current and prospective donors
Excellent strategic planning skills that incorporate short-term goal attainment with a long-term vision for sustainability
Ability to quickly build rapport and continuously develop trusting relationships with donors and stakeholders
Excellent written/verbal communication and story-telling skills
Excellent leadership, teamwork, management, and supervisory skills
Excellent ability to adapt, remain flexible, navigate challenges, and demonstrate problem-solving skills
Ability to work within a low-resourced organization
High levels of cultural intelligence, creativity, innovation, resourcefulness, and reliability
Proactive, motivated, self-starter with excellent ability for working with a high degree of autonomy and accountability
Deep understanding of, passion for, and commitment to TBB's mission and values
Knowledge of tax planning principles and techniques that favor charitable giving
Proficient in Google Workspace
Willing to commit 5-10 hours per week, with flexibility throughout the week to ensure availability for donor communication and team collaboration. Some evening and weekend hours may be required for outreach or event participation.
Must be based in the USA.
